allowTitle: What NIVO will be allowed to do
allowOnlyFiles: NIVO can only see and edit the files it creates itself, such as the "NIVO · Orders" spreadsheet.
allowNoOthers: It cannot open your other Drive files, your email or your contacts.
allowRevoke: You can take the access back at any time in your Google account settings or by disconnecting here.
unavailable: NIVO has not turned on the Google integration yet. Please try again later.
errNotConfigured: Google is not set up on this NIVO yet. Please try again later.
errStart: Could not start the Google connection. Please try again.
doneBody: Account: {email}. Switch on "Record orders in a Google Sheet" under Automations and NIVO creates the spreadsheet for you.
failDenied: Google did not allow the connection. If you pressed Cancel, press Connect Google again and accept.
failUnavailable: NIVO has not turned on the Google integration yet. Please try again later.
failState: The connection link expired. Press Connect Google again.
failGeneric: Something went wrong while connecting. Press Connect Google again.
failNoRefresh: Google did not grant lasting access. Press Connect Google again and accept every permission.
lostHint: Google access was taken back or expired. Reconnect to continue recording.
